meta.title: Developer API
meta.description: Bronevik public API: WN8 and recent periods, player history, server-wide tank statistics, marks of excellence thresholds, clans and sessions. Free key, TypeScript SDK and webhooks.

hero.title: «Мир танков» data <hot>straight into your code</hot>
hero.lead: WN8, recent periods, player history, server-wide tank stats, MoE thresholds and sessions — everything the Lesta API does not give you, in one REST call. Free key, TypeScript SDK, webhooks for new marks.

console.label: Sample request: a player profile with WN8 in one call
console.title: telemetry · GET /v1/players

plans.title: Limits for any project
plans.description: Free is open right away — for a clan bot, a stream widget or your own tracker. Pro and Partner are for heavy traffic.
plans.legal: Lesta’s terms forbid commercial redistribution of their API data. So Pro and Partner will only cover our own derived data (WN8, history, thresholds, mod data), and only after written approval from Lesta. Until then they are available on request, free of charge.

taglines.free: A clan bot, an OBS widget, a personal MoE tracker — plenty of headroom.
taglines.pro: Public services and bots serving thousands of players.
taglines.partner: Large platforms and mods with live traffic.

quickstart.title: First response in three minutes
quickstart.description: A key, the SDK and one call. Every response is JSON, every error carries a machine-readable code.

key.title: Grab a key
key.text: Sign in and create a key in the <link>developer dashboard</link>. The secret is shown once — save it right away.

install.title: Install the SDK
install.text: bun add @bronevik/sdk — types, retries and webhook verification out of the box. Or send the X-API-Key header from any language.

request.title: Make a request
request.text: A nickname or an account id — and you get a summary with WN8, EFF, Броня-Индекс and every recent period.

explorer.title: Every /v1 endpoint
explorer.description: A live list built from the server’s OpenAPI spec. Expand a row for parameters, response codes and a ready-made curl.
explorer.errorHint: The API server did not answer. The full documentation is still available at /v1/docs.
explorer.emptyHint: Try part of a path, like “marks” or “sessions”.

webhooks.title: Events come to you
webhooks.description: Follow players or clans and the server sends you a POST when someone earns a mark, finishes a session or changes clan.

events.markGained: A player earned a new mark of excellence. Fires for followed players and members of followed clans.
events.sessionEnded: A player finished a play session: battles, wins, average damage and session WN8.
events.clanMemberChanged: A clan roster changed: someone joined, left or got a new role.

headers.signature: sha256=… signature — HMAC-SHA256 with the webhook secret over “send time, a dot, the raw body”.
headers.timestamp: Send time in Unix seconds. Part of the signature.
headers.event: Event name, same as the event field.
headers.delivery: Delivery id — use it for idempotency.

notes.tolerance: Reject deliveries older than {minutes} minutes — it guards against replays.
notes.retries: A failed delivery is retried up to {count} times with growing backoff.
notes.disable: After {count} failures in a row the webhook is switched off — turn it back on in the dashboard.

showcase.title: Your project goes here
showcase.text: We are putting together a showcase of bots, widgets and trackers built on the Bronevik API. Made something useful for tankers? Tell us and it will be among the first here.

meta.title: Developer dashboard
meta.description: Bronevik API keys, request statistics, error log and webhooks.

header.title: API and webhooks
header.lead: Keys, quota usage, request errors and webhook deliveries — everything about your integrations in one place.

warning.key: Copy the key and store it in a secret manager or an environment variable. Once this window closes you cannot see it again — only issue a new one.
warning.webhook: Every delivery is signed with this secret. Save it now: it will not be shown again after this window closes.

keys.title: API keys
keys.description: Send the key in the X-API-Key header. Up to {max} active keys per account.
keys.limit: You have reached {max} active keys — revoke one you no longer need to issue a new one.
keys.emptyHint: Create your first key and start calling /v1.
keys.revokeText: Key “{name}” stops working immediately and every request with it gets a 401. This cannot be undone.

createKey.title: New API key
createKey.description: Name the key after the project so you always know where it is used.
createKey.secretDescription: Copy it now — the dashboard keeps only its prefix.
createKey.name: Name

errors.name: Name must be 1 to {max} characters
errors.server: The server did not create the key. Try again.

usage.title: Requests and errors
usage.description: How many requests each key sends, where it stumbles and how much of today’s quota is left.
usage.noKeysHint: Statistics appear once you have at least one key.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.description: The server POSTs to your URL when a followed player earns a mark, finishes a session, or a clan roster changes.
webhooks.limit: {count} of {max} webhooks used on your plan.
webhooks.emptyHint: Add a URL and events will start coming in.
webhooks.deleteText: Deliveries to {url} stop, and the delivery log goes with the webhook.
webhooks.failures: {count, plural, one {# failure in a row} other {# failures in a row}}

create.title: New webhook
create.description: https only. Follow players, clans or both.

edit.title: Edit webhook
edit.description: Editing does not change the signing secret.

secret.title: Webhook created
secret.description: Verify every delivery’s signature with this secret.

webhookForm.urlHint: It must answer 2xx within a few seconds.
webhookForm.idsHint: Separated by commas or spaces, up to {max} ids.
webhookForm.clanIdsHint: A clan also brings its members’ events.

errors.ids: Only positive numbers separated by commas or spaces
errors.filterEmpty: Add at least one player or clan
errors.filterTooMany: No more than {max} ids in a list
